page.overview:
Who is Poo Poo Platter Waiter?

The Poo Poo Platter Waiter is a minor character in A Bug's Life. He is an unnamed beetle who works as one of the waiters in the Bug Bar.

""Hey, who ordered the Poo Poo platter?" a harried beetle waiter shouts. Flies instantly buzz the platter of stinky treats while he's still holding it. Talk about eating on the fly. This makes fast food look slow."

He is briefly seen holding up a plate and loudly asking, "Hey, who ordered the Poo Poo platter?" (attracting the attention of various flies).
